reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, and all providers share one prepareBankAccountLink guard; but the holder detach rewrites the field-clearing that unlinkAccount already does instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The holder query is written twice in link.ts (ensureAccountIsNotLinked and replaceExistingAccountLink), the unlink field list is copied from unlinkAccount, and downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-copy of the Akahu downloader.

placement.why: Link rules live in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank and are composed once in app.ts, server config and provider types are added where siblings live; the guard is called per provider rather than inside linkBankSyncAccount, which most providers do not use yet.

scope.why: Mostly on task, with a gratuitous reformat of LinkBankSyncAccountParams and an expansion of the DbAccount sync-source union beyond what the steps need.

maintainability.why: One composed guard per link is easy to follow, but changing what 'holds a link' means or what unlinking clears now has to be done in two or three places.

disguised_duplication.where: replaceExistingAccountLink repeats ensureAccountIsNotLinked's holder query with reflowed SQL, and repeats unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount clearing block under a new name

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gains replaceExistingLink and an if/else between replace and ensure; unlinkAccount keeps its own copy of the link-clearing logic instead of sharing it with replaceExistingAccountLink
